Question:
For order 423, identify the product IDs, aisles, and positions from which to pick the exact quantities needed for each order line, ensuring that the total picked quantity for each product matches the cumulative quantities ordered without exceeding the available inventory in warehouse 1. Calculate the quantities to be picked from each location by prioritizing inventory with earlier purchased dates and smaller quantities, and ensure that picking respects the sequence and cumulative quantities of the order lines for products with multiple entries.

4 candidates were produced independently. Each shows its SQL and the first rows of its result.

WITH order_lines_cte AS (
    SELECT product_id, qty as order_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY product_id, qty) as rn
    FROM orderlines
    WHERE order_id = 423
),
inventory_sorted AS (
    SELECT 
        i.product_id,
        i.location_id,
        l.aisle,
        l.position,
        i.purchase_id,
        i.qty,
        p.purchased,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased, i.qty ASC) as rn
    FROM inventory i
    JOIN locations l ON i.location_id = l.id
    JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id = p.id
    WHERE i.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_lines_cte)
    AND l.warehouse = 1
),
order_total AS (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(order_qty) as total_order_qty
    FROM order_lines_cte
    GROUP BY product_id
),
picking AS (
    SELECT 
        inv.product_id,
        inv.location_id,
        inv.aisle,
        inv.position,
        inv.qty as avail_qty,
        inv.rn,
        ot.total_order_qty,
        CASE 
            WHEN COALESCE(ot.total_order_qty - SUM(inv.qty) OVER (PARTITION BY inv.product_id ORDER BY inv.rn ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), ot.total_order_qty) > 0 
            THEN LEAST(inv.qty, COALESCE(ot.total_order_qty - SUM(inv.qty) OVER (PARTITION BY inv.product_id ORDER BY inv.rn ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), ot.total_order_qty))
            ELSE 0 
        END as pick_qty
    FROM inventory_sorted inv
    JOIN order_total ot ON inv.product_id = ot.product_id
)

WITH RECURSIVE order_lines AS (
    SELECT order_id, product_id, qty as order_qty,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY id) AS line_seq
    FROM orderlines 
    WHERE order_id = 423
),
product_inventory AS (
    SELECT ol.product_id, ol.order_qty,
           i.location_id, i.qty AS inv_qty, i.purchase_id,
           l.warehouse, l.aisle, l.position, p.purchased,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY ol.product_id 
               ORDER BY p.purchased, i.qty
           ) AS rn
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN inventory i ON ol.product_id = i.product_id
    JOIN locations l ON i.location_id = l.id
    JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id = p.id
    WHERE l.warehouse = 1
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY rn) as rn_num
    FROM product_inventory
),
rec_calc(product_id, rn_num, inv_qty, aisle, position, location_id, purchased, rn, order_qty, prev_pick_total, pick_qty) AS (
    SELECT r.product_id, r.rn_num, r.inv_qty, r.aisle, r.position, r.location_id, r.purchased, r.rn, r.order_qty, 0, LEAST(r.inv_qty, r.order_qty)
    FROM ranked r
    WHERE r.rn_num = 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.product_id, r.rn_num, r.inv_qty, r.aisle, r.position, r.location_id, r.purchased, r.rn, r.order_qty, 
           COALESCE(prev_pick_total + pick_qty, 0),
           LEAST(r.inv_qty, COALESCE(r.order_qty - (prev_pick_total + pick_qty), 0))
    FROM ranked r
    JOIN rec_calc rc ON r.product_id = rc.product_id AND r.rn_num = rc

WITH order_qty AS (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) as total_qty
    FROM orderlines
    WHERE order_id = 423
    GROUP BY product_id
),
inventory_with_order AS (
    SELECT 
        i.id as inv_id,
        i.location_id,
        i.product_id,
        i.purchase_id,
        i.qty as inv_qty,
        l.aisle,
        l.position,
        p.purchased,
        o.total_qty as order_qty_needed,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased, i.qty) as rn,
        SUM(i.qty) OVER (PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased, i.qty ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) as cum_inv_qty
    FROM inventory i
    JOIN locations l ON i.location_id = l.id
    JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id = p.id
    JOIN order_qty o ON i.product_id = o.product_id
    WHERE l.warehouse = 1
),
with_prev AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        LAG(cum_inv_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY rn) as prev_cum_inv_qty
    FROM inventory_with_order
),
picked AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        aisle,
        position,
        CASE 
            WHEN prev_cum_inv_qty IS NULL OR prev_cum_inv_qty < order_qty_needed
            THEN LEAST(inv_qty, order_qty_needed - prev_cum_inv_qty)
            ELSE 0
        END as picked_qty
    FROM with_prev
)
SELECT product_id, aisle, position, picked_qty
FROM picked
WHERE picked_qty > 0
ORDER BY product_id, aisle, position
